items.title: The Road to Edo
items.hook: Post towns existed to serve walkers, horses and official mail.

items.title: What Is Missing?
items.task: Look for wires, cars, vending, neon. What did they hide or keep out?
items.notes: TSU-03 Traveller Test and TSU-06 Walk Without Technology are cut.

items.title: Government Noticeboard
items.task: If you find a kosatsu, or a reproduction, read who was talking to travellers.

items.title: Who Protects Travellers?
items.task: Find a stone roadside figure. Jizo or dōsojin: protectors of the way.

moreInfo.title: Inland
moreInfo.text: The Nakasendo ran inland. The Tōkaidō hugged the coast. Different weather, different control. Confirm the comparison before live.
